text:
sam: rolling out gpu-pool autoscaler in us-west-2 via Terraform. apply completed but new nodes are up in ASG and not joining the cluster — pods stay Pending with 'No nodes are available that match the requested resources'. anyone on call?

ops-bot: [ALERT] kube-system/aws-node DS CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-canary-2 (reported by cluster-health).

priya: can you paste kubelet / aws-node logs? did the argocd/helm CNI upgrade go through for this cluster?

jun: quick guess: CNI version mismatch between addon + node AMI. seen aws-vpc-cni chart v1.14 vs nodes shipping older binary -> aws-node daemonset crash because ipam plugin API changed. run: 
```
kubectl -n kube-system get ds aws-node -o wide
kubectl -n kube-system logs ds/aws-node
```
look for "failed to allocate pod ip" or "ENI setup error".

sam: logs attached from new node (trimmed):
```
[kubelet] I0304 18:02:11.345 kubelet.go:200] Node registering with name gpu-canary-2
[aws-cni] E0304 18:02:15.122 ipamd.go:512] Error getting available IPs: no available IPs for pods
aws-node: crashloopbackoff: unable to start ENI plugin
```

maya: if aws-node is crashlooping, don't scale the nodegroup more. rollback the CNI chart in argocd to the previous working revision or pin the addon in terraform. steps: pause argocd sync for infra-cni, rollback to last stable, then canary a single node group with the updated chart. also drain new gpu nodes gracefully (avoid killing long-running GPU jobs):
```
kubectl drain gpu-canary-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
```
and make sure GPU pods have PodDisruptionBudget so they don't get evicted mid-job. :warning:

priya: agree — add a PDB for training jobs and set the cluster-autoscaler annotation to respect PDBs. For short-term: mark new nodes unschedulable or remove from ASG to prevent further joins. Also check spot/interruptions — if these are spot nodes we might be getting evicted and then CNI can't finish bootstrap.

jun: terraform fix suggestion: update the aws_eks_addon / helm values to pin aws-vpc-cni to the cluster-compatible version and add warm IP config. example terraform snippet (conceptual):
```
resource "aws_eks_addon" "vpc_cni" {
  cluster_name = var.cluster
  addon_name   = "vpc-cni"
  addon_version = "v1.13.4"  # pin back to working version
  resolve_conflicts = "OVERWRITE"
}
# or helm values: image.tag: "v1.13.4"
```
Also consider enabling WARM_IP_TARGET=5 so IP exhaustion is less likely during scale-up.

sam: i'm opening a PR to infra/gitops with: rollback cni chart to v1.13.4, add nodegroup canary (min=1 max=2), and a PDB for gpu-jobs. pausing argocd sync on infra-cni now — @maya can you review the PR quickly? :rocket:

ops-bot: argocd: application "infra-cni" sync paused by sam at 2026-03-04T18:12:45Z.

maya: on it, will review and apply canary after we confirm aws-node stable. once canary healthy we can promote. assign follow-ups: sam -> PR + argocd pause, jun -> terraform addon pin + doc, priya -> add PDBs and update autoscaler annotations.

sam: thanks — i'll post updates in this thread when canary node becomes Ready.
